Initial release of Language Specialist—an expert coding skill for every major programming language.

- Supports idiomatic code writing, refactoring, optimization, review, migration, and debugging across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Elixir, SQL, and blockchain languages.
- Automatically adapts methodologies and community standards per language via dedicated expertise modes.
- Includes comprehensive guidelines for best practices, testing, documentation, and project setup in each supported language.
- Ensures all output meets strict style, type-checking, and documentation requirements per language.
- Activates on a wide range of development and code-base management requests, including setup, testing, benchmarking, and tooling recommendations.
